mira: Heads-up — kicked off a graded canary for rwd-v6-int4-lite (5% start, 30m window). Seeing divergence on a long-doc slice 'legal-forms' (MRR down ~2.3%) and p95 latency up ~12%. Need consensus on auto-fallback rules.
sam: Can you paste the short snapshot numbers? we should codify thresholds with concrete values.
mira: Snapshot: overall MRR delta -0.9%, slice[legal-forms] MRR delta -2.3%, hallucination +0.15pp, p95 +12% (220ms -> 246ms), error rate ~= stable. Quick log: `agg: {mrr_delta:-0.009, slice[legal-forms].mrr_delta:-0.023, p95_delta:0.12}`
cheng: Suggest split: soft-fail vs hard-fail. Soft: any slice <= -1.5% after 15m -> pause increase, spawn shadow runs. Hard: immediate rollback if any critical slice <= -2.0% OR p95 increase >20% OR hallucination delta >0.5pp. Use rolling average over 3 windows to avoid noisy spikes.
alix: Also add a long-context guard: quant tends to regress >2048 tokens. Bias traffic away from longdocs during warmup. Start at 3% and step only after kv-warm confirmed / 1h without soft-fails.
mira: Proposed automated policy (yaml-friendly):
```
initial_percent: 5
step: 5
step_interval_mins: 30
max_percent: 25
soft_thresholds:
  slice_mrr_drop_pp: 1.5  # trigger if >=1.5% drop on any slice (15m window)
hard_thresholds:
  slice_mrr_drop_pp: 2.0
  p95_delta_fraction: 0.20
  hallucination_delta_pp: 0.5
cooldown_mins: 60
on_soft_hit: reduce_percent_to: 3
```
If hard_threshold hit -> immediate rollback + tag reason.
ops-bot: deploybot: seen promote attempt for rwd-v6-int4-lite; canary_rule 'graded-consensus-v1' in effect.
sam: Agree on automation but be conservative for safety-critical slices like legal-forms. For those, consider excluding from initial canary or tighten hard_mrr_drop to 1.0% for that slice.
cheng: Excluding high-risk slices is reasonable. Also require a minimum sample size: >=500 requests per slice in the eval window to make a decision, otherwise aggregate to cohort-level delta.
mira: I'll update rollout config and push `promote.yaml`. Command to apply: `deployctl apply -f promote.yaml --canary`
alix: Add automatic rollback tags for audit, e.g. `rollback_reason=canary:legal-forms-mrr-drop`.
mira: Will patch and re-run: start at 3% with legal-forms excluded, longer warmup. Will post results.
sam: If we still see >1% drop on legal-forms, do full shadow compare and human rater evaluation for that slice.
cheng: Ack, tagging ops on-call.
ops-bot: incident-bot: created alert INC-2027 for canary MRR delta >1% on slice legal-forms. Pager duty: @cheng
mira: Update 18m in: after excluding legal-forms, overall MRR delta -0.5%, p95 +8%, hallucination flat. Holding at 3%.
alix: :thumbsup: Good. Please attach sample id list for shadow runs.
mira: Added sample IDs to the ticket https://tickets/infra/4273. Will re-run with longer kv warmup next window.
sam: I'll draft a Gatebook PR to formalize these thresholds and the exclusion-list semantics.
cheng: Also recommend adding a postmortem checklist step: when a rollback occurs include sample diff, top-10 tokens where kv mismatched, and per-slice human-rater notes.
mira: Agreed. Rolling this into the promote.yaml and gatebook. Thanks all.
